Tent Rentals Nova Scotia

Nova Kingdom Rentals offers two tent rentals from Bridgewater, Nova Scotia. The 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent is $100 self-serve or $150 with setup and takedown — weight bags included — and suits shade or light cover for food tables, welcome tables, markets, and small seating areas. The 20x20 Pole Tent is $300 self-serve or $400 with setup and takedown, covers a full dining or seating area for larger backyard parties, community events, and fundraisers, and requires a stakeable grass surface with stakes and guy ropes. Both are open-sided tents, not enclosed event tents. Tents must stay anchored at all times and must not be used in high winds, storms, unsafe weather, or on unsuitable surfaces. Final availability, setup approval, delivery, and pricing are confirmed manually.

Nova Kingdom Rentals is based in Bridgewater, Nova Scotia. We serve the South Shore, Annapolis Valley, HRM, and surrounding areas. Delivery: the first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Availability, quantity, delivery, and final pricing are confirmed manually based on your event date, location, and order size.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does tent rental cost?
The 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent is $100 self-serve or $150 with setup and takedown. The 20x20 Pole Tent is $300 self-serve or $400 with setup and takedown. Delivery is free for the first 15 km from Bridgewater, then $0.72/km.
What is the difference between self-serve and full-service?
Self-serve means you set the tent up and take it down yourself. Full-service means our team handles setup and takedown for you — $150 for the 10x10 and $400 for the 20x20.
What surface do the tents need?
The 10x10 pop-up comes with weight bags and suits most flat, clear areas. The 20x20 pole tent uses stakes and guy ropes, so it requires a stakeable grass surface with clear space around the perimeter. Setup suitability is confirmed before booking.
Are these enclosed event tents?
No. Both are open-sided canopy tents for shade and light cover. Tents must stay anchored at all times and must not be used in high winds, storms, unsafe weather, or on unsuitable surfaces.
Can I add tables and chairs to a tent rental?
Yes. Chairs from $3 each and 6 ft tables from $8 each can be added to any tent booking. See our chair rentals and table rentals pages for details.
